capabilities: Assemble a configurable Home dashboard of widgets for tasks, projects, inbox, habits, and statistics
Plan tasks on a board with month, week, day, and matrix views plus a project timeline
Track habits with check-ins stored in dated Markdown
Chart note growth, task completion, and heatmaps over configurable time ranges
Write daily-to-yearly diary entries and reviews that autosave to date notes
extras: README documents the development version and includes unreleased improvements beyond the 0.5.0 release; full documentation lives in a separate User Guide. Privacy notes: no account, telemetry, or AI calls; weather is off until enabled and contacts services like Open-Meteo; custom JavaScript widgets are disabled by default and execute vault files with broad access when enabled. Voluntary donation support (Alipay) is requested, with all features free.
problem: Obsidian scatters daily records, tasks, habits, and periodic reviews across separate notes and views, with no unified dashboard to plan and reflect on them.

relations.evidence: The sidebar Calendar locates period notes using Noria-managed paths, Obsidian Daily Notes, or a custom folder
An external assistant such as Codex can write to that same source for you to review

summary: Configurable workbench that combines a widget dashboard, task board and timeline, habits, statistics, diary, and periodic reviews over the same vault notes.
